description_en: Creates a user and adds the user to a tenant
name: CreateUser

parameters.help_en: The ID of the tenant in which the operation takes effect
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The WINNEXO logon account (unique identifier, required)
parameters.help_zh: WINNEXO 登录账号（唯一标识，不可为空）
parameters.name: wn_account_id

parameters.help_en: The list of new system role codes (full replacement, must contain at least one role). Valid values: SUPER_ADMIN, SYSTEM_ADMIN, SEMANTIC_ADMIN, SKILL_ADMIN, KB_ADMIN, AGENT_ADMIN, and APPLICATION_USER
parameters.help_zh: 新的系统角色 code 列表（全量替换，至少包含一个角色）。可选值: SUPER_ADMIN / SYSTEM_ADMIN / SEMANTIC_ADMIN / SKILL_ADMIN / KB_ADMIN / AGENT_ADMIN / APPLICATION_USER
parameters.name: role_codes

parameters.help_en: The base64-encoded password ciphertext encrypted by RSA-OAEP-SHA256 (required)
parameters.help_zh: RSA-OAEP-SHA256 加密后的 base64 密码密文（必填，不可为空）
parameters.name: password_encrypted
